title: Capstone: Build and Prove a Hardened Application Gateway
description: Assemble everything this course covered into one host: LVM storage owned by a locked service account, SSH on a non-default port, a default-deny firewall, a rootless container on loopback behind a reverse proxy, and a health check on a timer. Then run the validation script and get every check to pass.

steps.title: Storage and the account that owns it
SSH on a port of your choosing
Firewall, and the application behind it
